name: Peddler's rest
description: A trader's handcart pulled off the verge for a few hours — THE ROAD'S FORTUNE (living-frontier Phase 5). Never rolls on its own (weight 0): the renewal path occasionally deals fortune instead of trouble, road-true and rare. The ember clock is stamped ON ARRIVAL — nobody solves a peddler; she packs the cart and moves on, and the chart remembers her as rumor.
